# Daily Briefing – Monday 19 October

Yesterday was a rest day, but the data tells an important story. Only 3.5 hours of sleep is a real concern — paired with a stress score of 58/100, your body was under pressure even without training. Steps at 4,622 kept you lightly active, and calories burned of 2,283 kcal sat just under your 2,300 target, which is solid.

Your HRV at 103ms sits at the lower end of your 99–121ms baseline, and that resting HR of 51 bpm is healthy — but the sleep deprivation is the dominant signal here. If training is scheduled today, keep intensity easy. A Zone 2 run or gentle movement is fine; hard efforts can wait until you've recovered proper sleep.

Tonight, prioritise sleep above everything. Aim for 8 hours — no screens after 9pm. Hit your 175g protein today to protect muscle, and consider a small magnesium-rich snack before bed.
